title: Which engine blocked the file, and what a Sandbox verdict means
aliases: blocked by sandbox vs malware protection vs atp
sandbox says benign but file is blocked

blocked-policy-type.statement: The Blocked Policy Type field in Web Insights logs identifies which security control is responsible for a block: Sandbox, Malware Protection, or Advanced Threat Protection. The log also carries Policy Action and Threat Super Category.

quotes: The Blocked Policy Type in Web Insights logs identifies which security control is responsible:
Threat Super Category from Web Insights logs

mp-atp-no-transaction-api.statement: The MCP server has no tool to investigate a Malware Protection or ATP block: its guidance for those two policy types is advisory, and a transaction is attributed through Web Insights logs. The SDKs expose Malware Protection and ATP only as policy settings and lists, not per-transaction verdicts.
mp-atp-no-transaction-api.conditions: The first sentence is the skill's own statement. The second rests on reading the Go service files: every function there reads or writes a settings or list endpoint under /cyberThreatProtection/. Absence in two SDKs is not proof the API has no such endpoint.

quotes: ZIA Malware Protection | No API -- advisory guidance only
ZIA ATP | No API -- advisory guidance only
/zia/api/v1/cyberThreatProtection/advancedThreatSettings
/zia/api/v1/cyberThreatProtection/malwarePolicy

classification-types.statement: A Sandbox report's Classification type is MALICIOUS, SUSPICIOUS or BENIGN. MALICIOUS means the block is expected; BENIGN means Sandbox should not be the blocker and the investigation moves to other policies; SUSPICIOUS calls for reading the behavioral indicators in the full report.

quotes: If `MALICIOUS` -- the block is expected behavior; the sandbox correctly identified the threat
If `SUSPICIOUS` -- review the behavioral indicators in the full report
If `BENIGN` -- the file should not be blocked by Sandbox; look for other policies

benign-not-clean.statement: A BENIGN Sandbox verdict covers only Sandbox. A file Sandbox cleared can still be blocked by Malware Protection, ATP or File Type Control, and URL Filtering can block before Sandbox is reached. The source's first suspects for a block under a BENIGN verdict are Malware Protection and ATP.

quotes: look for other policies (Malware Protection, ATP, File Type Control)
check URL filtering (may block before sandbox)
should not be blocked by sandbox; check Malware Protection or ATP

sandbox-row.statement: For a Sandbox block the investigation is API-driven: take the file's MD5 from the Web Insights log and fetch its Sandbox report, check the quota, the blocked-hash list and the hash count. The tools are the report, quota, behavioral-analysis and file-hash-count calls.

quotes: File MD5 hash (if available from Web Insights logs)
`zia_get_sandbox_quota()` -- check quota usage and subscription limits
`zia_get_sandbox_behavioral_analysis()` -- list of MD5 hashes blocked by sandbox

mp-atp-python-surfaces.statement: The Python SDK exposes Malware Protection (`malware_protection_policy`) as get/update pairs for the malware policy, malware inspection, malware protocols and malware settings, and ATP (`atp_policy`) as get/update settings plus security-exception and malicious-URL list calls. None returns a per-transaction verdict.

mp-atp-diagnosis-api.title: Whether any ZIA API attributes a single transaction to Malware Protection or ATP
mp-atp-diagnosis-api.detail: The MCP skill says there is no API for Malware Protection or ATP diagnosis and the two SDKs expose settings only; whether the ZIA API has any per-transaction endpoint is not established by a source.

quotes: No API -- advisory guidance only

sandbox-first-engine.title: Unverified legacy statement: a file blocked by Sandbox is blocked before any other engine sees it
sandbox-first-engine.detail: Unverified legacy statement: The earlier reference asserted this engine ordering. The help page points to About Policy Enforcement for the order of enforcement, which is not captured.

confidence-score.title: Unverified legacy statement: a Sandbox Detail Report confidence score
confidence-score.detail: Unverified legacy statement: The earlier decision tree said to check the report for a confidence score. The report model has Classification Score; no source calls it a confidence score or says how to use it.
